verdicts.reason: A keeps the 'Perfect Taste' wordmark inside its gold wreath as one unit, but it is shrunk to a tiny stamp in the middle of a thin strip, so most of the banner is dead blurred background. The crop also turns the figs into unreadable fragments and makes no use of the wide format. B is worse: it splits the wreath from the text, leaving the wreath cut off at the bottom edge on top of the busy fig image, while the bare tiny text sits off-centre on its own, so the signature lockup is broken.
